## Current bench implementation

The UPduino reads the MCP3204 over SPI, forms a two-channel Hall readout, presents a measurement word to the MCU over a separate SPI interface, and generates a duty sweep for the electromagnet MOSFET. The current [top module](fpga/pwm_sweeper/top.sv) connects these blocks. Acquisition and live-word transfer are still being debugged; the sweep operates without position feedback.

| Block | Source | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| ADC SPI master | [adc_spi.sv](fpga/pwm_sweeper/adc_spi.sv) | Channel selection, serial acquisition, and channel subtraction |
| MCU-facing sender | [spi_byte_tx.sv](fpga/pwm_sweeper/spi_byte_tx.sv) | Contains `spi_word_tx`, a 16-bit mode-0 measurement sender |
| Duty sweep | [sweep_8bit.sv](fpga/pwm_sweeper/sweep_8bit.sv) | Varies an 8-bit duty command up and down |
| PWM | [pwm.sv](fpga/pwm_sweeper/pwm.sv) and [counter.sv](fpga/pwm_sweeper/counter.sv) | Counter-based output generation |
| Pin assignments | [pins.pcf](fpga/pwm_sweeper/pins.pcf) | ADC pads 44/13/18/9, MCU pads 21/20/12, PWM pad 10 |

## Data path and integration

Hall A and Hall B connect to MCP3204 CH0 and CH1. The acquisition code alternates channels and forms a difference. The ADC interface runs from the FPGA clock, while the measurement sender advances on the MCU's SPI clock. A stable snapshot or equivalent coherent handoff is needed before treating a changing measurement as a reliable transferred word.

The ADC result width is 12 bits, the MCU transfer is 16 bits, and the duty command is 8 bits. Subtraction sign, overflow, channel alignment, initialization, and sampling boundaries remain verification work. The latest no-magnet debug readings varied substantially, so raw output is not yet a calibrated position measurement.

## PWM experiment

The PWM block compares an 8-bit counter against the duty command. Its prescaler and 256-count cycle give a nominal period of **2304 FPGA clock ticks**. At an assumed 48 MHz input this corresponds to approximately **20.8 kHz**; this is a calculation from the source, not a measured scope result. The oscillator setting and actual output frequency must be checked for the programmed build.

The current sweeper output is pad 10. Earlier fixed-frequency pad-36 tests are separate experiments. See the [power-stage schematic](progress.qmd#electromagnet-and-pwm-testing) and [reported bench observations](results.qmd).

## Feedback and earlier HDL

Position estimation, a validated control law, duty limits, and measured fault/shutdown behavior remain system integration work. The present duty sweep is an open-loop actuation test.

[lev_core.sv](fpga/rtl/lev_core.sv), [current_pi.sv](fpga/rtl/current_pi.sv), and [spi_frame.sv](fpga/rtl/spi_frame.sv) implement the earlier full application. Their [October 26 verification](docs/verification.qmd) does not establish the behavior or resource use of the current ADC/PWM build. The separate [fixed-byte sender](simple_byte/spi_byte.sv) and [testbench](simple_byte/tb_spi_byte.sv) record the earlier communication experiment.
